transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi. It's nice to meet you too. 

I’m here because... well, for months now, I’ve been seeing this exact same pattern in my project files at work. I work as a translator, and certain subcontractors, along with one colleague in particular, keep making these tiny changes to the translation memory and the file timestamps. 

It's set up specifically to make it look like my quality control failed. I actually brought it up to our IT department, but they told me the audit trail is clean. But I know what I'm seeing. I know the digital record has been deliberately arranged to put the blame on me for these errors, and it's just becoming impossible to deal with on my own.
Even when IT shows you a clean audit trail, are you completely certain your colleague is still altering the files?

Yes, I am completely certain. I know what IT told me about the audit trail being clean, but... well, they are just looking at the standard logs. 

I've been a translator for a long time, and I know exactly how our translation memory works. These subcontractors and that one colleague are making tiny, very specific changes to the files. It's not a glitch or a mistake. Even if they managed to make the timestamps look normal to the IT department, I know what I'm looking at. The digital record has been deliberately arranged to put the blame on me for those errors. So, yes, I have no doubt they are still doing it.
During this period, have you had a time when your mood was extremely high or unusually irritable?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I haven't felt unusually high or irritable, just... frustrated by what's happening at work. But my mood itself has been pretty normal.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
No, I haven't heard any voices. Nothing like that. It's just the files and the changes they're making to them. My hearing is perfectly fine, and I don't hear things that aren't there.
Have you had the feeling that someone can put thoughts into your mind or take thoughts out of it?

No, definitely not. I've never felt like anyone is messing with my mind or my thoughts. My thoughts are my own. The issue is entirely with the computer files and what my colleague is doing to them, not anything inside my head.
Aside from this problem at work, have you become noticeably less interested in people or activities you used to care about?

No, not at all. Outside of this whole project issue, things are pretty much normal. I still translate, manage my team’s workflow, pay the bills, and keep up with all my usual family routines. I haven't lost interest in any of that. 

The only place things really go off track is when the file history or certain coworkers come up. But other than that, my life is exactly the same.
Have you been diagnosed with any brain or nervous system illness?
No, I haven't. I've never had any issues with my brain or my nervous system. I'm completely healthy in that regard. Like I said, the only problem is what's happening at work with my files.
Have you seen things that other people could not see?
No, I haven't. I've never seen anything that wasn't actually there, or that other people couldn't see. My vision is perfectly normal, I just see what everyone else sees.
How long have you been certain that your colleague and the subcontractors are altering your work files?
It's been about 11 months now. It started shortly after I was put in charge of the new localization project.
Have other people told you that your speech or the way you express your thoughts has become hard to follow or disorganized?

No, no one has ever said anything like that. I mean, as a translator, my whole job relies on clear communication. I haven't noticed any issues with how I speak, and no one else has mentioned that I'm hard to follow or... disorganized. I express myself just fine.
